The primary cellular mechanism enriched in the CBD/cisplatin combination treatment is hypoxia/HIF-1 signaling (Reactome: the hypoxia-inducible factor signaling pathway) — predominantly down-regulated, together with its downstream glycolysis program (with up-regulation of p53/cell-cycle arrest signaling as a secondary component).

(附注：因沙箱完全离线，gseapy/Enrichr 与官方 Reactome_2022 基因集库无法获取与运行；富集采用 gseapy.enrichr 等价算法（Fisher 精确检验+BH 校正）配合基于知识构建的 Reactome 主要通路近似基因集完成，该偏离已在分析脚本中明确标注。)
